explication: Gen1Recomp is a native LÖVE2D recreation of Pokémon generations 1 and 2. The principal workflow is: the player supplies a canonical ROM, the importer verifies and decodes it into a private cache, then the launcher starts the Lua-driven game. During play, SDL delivers controls, gameplay systems update world and battles, and the renderer/audio layers produce the result. The tree is dominated by bundled platform libraries; game Lua sources were not sampled, so those nodes and links rely on README capabilities and enclosing paths.
